tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sman bla'i mdo chog gi snying po bsdus pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// na mo gu ru mu ni in+d+ra ya/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ mnar med me yang rab bsil pad mtsho ltar// bsgyur mdzad snyigs ma'i mgon po bde gshegs bdun// shākya'i tog dang bcas pa'i zhabs btud nas/ mchog dman bya bas g.yengs shing rnam dpyod kyis// snyigs ma'i rgyal ba bdun gyi rnam thar la// mos pa'i blo ldan dag la phan pa'i phyir// mdo mchog bdud rtsi'i yang zhun snying po bris// 'dir snyigs ma'i dus su mthu dang byin rlabs ches cher myur bar 'phags pa'i bka' mi 'gyur bas zhal gyis bzhes pa snyigs ma'i mgon po bde gshegs bdun gyi thugs dam bskul ba'i snying po'i yang snying snying po nyams su len par 'dod pas/ mdo chog nas 'byung ba'i sbyor ba rnams sngon du btang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges pa byas te 'di ltar/ mchog bden rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*// tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings dag pa'i mthus// zhing 'di bde ba can ltar snod bcud kyi/ srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i 'byor gyur cig /rin chen sa gzhi ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan// gser dngul mu tig bye ma gram bur brdal// me tog gcal bkram tsan+dan dri bsung ldang*// lha mi'i longs spyod kun bzang mchod pas khyab/ der ni yid 'ong nor bu'i pho brang dbus/ pad+ma seng khrir rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// bzhugs nas gzungs rig mos stobs kyis bskrun pa'i/ mchod sprin rgya mtsho gang gis spyod gyur cig /snyigs ma'i mgon po brtse ldan bde gshegs bdun// thub dbang dam chos byang sems bka' sdod bcas// bdag sogs skyob phyir mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du// spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs gdan 'dzoms byin rlabs mdzod// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// shākya'i rgyal po 'jam dbyangs zhi 'tsho sogs// zab mo'i mdo 'di phyag mtshan bzhes pa yi// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyam thag 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i thugs rje can// bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang dam pa'i chos// 'jam dpal skyabs grol gsang bdag tshangs dbang dang*// rgyal chen gnod sbyin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// bcom ldan gdan 'dzoms chen po dgongs su gsol// bde gshegs bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam dag

/shākya'i bstan pa lnga brgya'i tha ma la// 'grub par 'gyur ba zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin// bdag la bden pa mngon sum bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan bdun brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o// gser gyi mdog can skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can// smon lam brgyad grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid// gzhan gyis mi thub zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan gyi me tog rgyas shing dag pa la// dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku// gang gis mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur pa// mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus// bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*/ nad rims gshed byed sdig can gdon las thar// dbang po kun tshang sdug bsngal sdig rgyun chad// ngan 'gror mi ltung lha mi'i bde ba myong*// bkres skom dbul 'phongs zhi zhing 'byor gyur cig /bcings dang brdeg sogs lus kyi gdung ba med// stag seng sbrul gyis 'tshe bral 'thab rtsod zhi/ byams pa'i sems ldan chu yis skrag rnams kyang*// dbugs phyin 'jigs med bde bar brgal gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi// zhing der pad+mo las skyes yon tan rdzogs// mtshan legs yongs bsgrags la sogs rgyal rnams kyi/ bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// sku mdog ser po mchog sbyin phyag rgya can// smon lam brgyad grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid/

rin chen ldan pa'i zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// rin chen zla ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen zla dang pad+mas rab brgyan cing*// shes bya kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas// rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i thugs mnga' ba// sgra dbyangs rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus// bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*// g.yengs rnams chos 'phel lha mi'i 'tshog chas 'byor// btsa' ba'i gdung bral rtag tu skyes par gyur/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral dge chos rgyas// sgrib byang lha mi'i bde ba thob gyur cig /bshes bral mun par gdon gtses 'chi dang dgra// dgon pa'i gnod med mchod dang rim gror brtson// dman rnams ting 'dzin dran stobs gzungs ldan cing*// shes rab mchog thob mes nyen bsil gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi// zhing der pad+mo las skyes yon tan rdzogs// sgra dbyangs rgyal po la sogs rgyal rnams kyi// bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzang dri med rin chen snang ba brtul zhugs grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// 'dzam bu'i gser 'dra chos ston phyag rgya can// smon lam bzhi grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid// spos kyis yongs gang zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba// nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar// dri med gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku// gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mchod mthus/

bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*// tshe thung ring 'tsho dbul rnams dbang phyug tshang*// 'thab rtsod 'gyed pa'ang byams pa'i sems ldan zhing*// bslab bral ngan song mi ltung sdom pas bsdams// byang chub sems dang 'bral ba med gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi// zhing der pad+mo las skyes yon tan rdzogs// gser bzang dri med la sogs rgyal rnams kyi// bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// sku mdog dmar skya mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can// smon lam bzhi grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid// mya ngan med pa'i zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// mya ngan med mchod dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// mya ngan 'das zhing bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa// 'gro ba'i dus gsum sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// 'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur pa yis// mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus// bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*// mya ngan phyogs zhi mi 'bral tshe ring bde// dmyal bar rgyal ba'i 'od kyis bde dga' rgyas// mdangs ldan mdzes 'byor 'byung pos mi 'tshe zhing*// phan tshun byams ldan nad rnams med gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi// zhing der pad+mo las skyes yon tan rdzogs// mya ngan med mchog la sogs rgyal rnams kyis/ bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// sku mdog dkar dmar chos ston phyag rgya can// smon lam bzhi grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid// chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos bsgrags chen pos pha rol rgol ba 'joms// rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i gsung mnga' zhing*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad pa// chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// bde ba yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus// bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*// rtag tu yang dag lta yang dad ldan zhing*// chos kyi sgra thos byang chub sems kyis phyug

/longs spyod slad du sdig spangs 'byor pa 'phel/ byams gnas tshe ring chog shes nyid gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi// zhing der pad+mo las skyes yon tan rdzogs// chos bsgrags rgya mtsho la sogs rgyal rnams kyi// bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byu ru'i mdog can mchog sbyin phyag rgya can// smon lam bzhi grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid// rin chen rgya mtsho'i zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// mngon mkhyen rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi blo gros gting dpag dka' ba'i thugs// rnam dag chos kyi dbyings la rol mdzad cing*// shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa pa po// mngon mkhyen rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus// bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*// g.yengs rnams gnod sems med cing 'tshog chas 'byor// ngan song lam ngan zhugs rnams dge bcu thob// gzhan dbang gyur rnams rang dbang phun tshogs shing*// kun kyang tshe ring mtshan thos dge gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi// zhing der pad+mo las skyes yon tan rdzogs// mngon mkhyen rgyal po la sogs rgyal rnams kyi// bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// sku mdog sngon po mchog sbyin phyag rgya can/

bcu gnyis smon grub tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid// bai ḍūr+ya snang zhing gi dpal gyur pa'i// sman pa'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rjes kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyibla// baiḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyi sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal ba'i mtshan thos dran brjod phyag mchod mthus// bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang*// mtshan dpes mdzes shing 'gro kun bdag 'drar gyur// 'od kyis mun sel shes rab thabs mkhas kyis// longs spyod mi zad lam log dman mos rnams// theg chen lam zhugs sdom pas mdzes gyur cig /tshul 'chal gdung bral dbang po kun tshang zhing*// nad med yo byad 'phel zhing bud med kyi// dngos pos skyo rnams rtag tu skyes dbang ldan// bdud zhags lta ba ngan las grol gyur cig /rgyal pos mnar rnams bde zhing bkres pa'i rgyus// sdig pas 'tsho rnams chos 'byor zas kyis tshim// tsha grang ngal zhi bsam pa yongs rdzogs shing*// 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul ldan grol gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos gyur tshe sangs rgyas kyi// zhing der pad+mo las skyes yon tan rdzogs// sman pa'i rgyal po la sogs rgyal rnams kyi// bka' lung nod cing mnyes par byed gyur cig /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// gser gyi mdog can sa gnon phyag rgya can// rmad byung thugs rje brtson 'grus chen po'i mthus// mi mjed 'jig rten khams kyi dpal gyur pa'i// 'dren mchog shākya'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// ston pa mchog des mdo sde'i cho ga las// ji ltar gsungs pa'i phan yon ma lus pa// bdag cag mgon med 'gro ba mtha' dag gis// deng 'dir 'phral du thob par byin gyis rlobs// ma rig mun sel sgron me mchog

/sdug bsngal nad sel sman gyi phul// dam chos dkon mchog thams cad la/ phyag 'tshal mchod cing skyabs su mchi// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags// dge la yi rang skul zhing gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// dam chos dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos ma lus pa// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /'jam dpal skyabs grol phyag na rdo rje sogs// bde gshegs sras po sum khri drug stong gis// rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskul zhing gleng bslangs nas// mdo sde'i phan yon ji skad gsungs pa rnams// deng 'dir bdag la mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod// 'jig rten skyong ba sde dpon bcas pas kyang*// sngon tshe ston pa'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin// dgra dang gnod pa nad rims bzlog pa dang*// 'thab rtsod kun zhi lus sems bde ba rgyas// longs spyod dbang phyug nor 'bru tshe 'phel zhing*// bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// rtag tu srung skyob g.yel ba med par mdzod// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye/ ma hā bhai ṣa dze bhai ṣa dz+ye/ rā dzā sa mud+ga te swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring ngam/ yang na/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ya bhai ṣa dz+ye/ ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye/ rā dzā sa mud+ga te swā hā/ zhes gzungs thung ci mang bzla bar bya'o// nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdon gyis myos pa yis// mgon med lnga brgya'i tha ma'i 'gro rnams la// thugs rjes dgongs nas shākya'i gtso bo des// snyigs ma'i rgyal ba bdun gyi thugs rje bskal// phan bde'i 'byung gnas mdo sde'i cho ga gsungs// thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tshos// mdo chog dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal spel// de med snying po'i yang snying yid bzhin nor// gang 'di deng dus rnam par g.yeng ldan pa// dad ldan 'ga' yi don du kho bos bkod// 'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge bas bdag gzhan kun*/

bde gshegs brgyad kyis dgyes bzhin 'dzin gyur cig /ces sman bla'i mdo chog gi snying po bsdus pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos smra ba shākya'i dge sbyong blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun por sbyar ba'o/// /
